# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>; Mrs. Irving  <sub>[v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Lavendar is a small lady with an almost girlish, pink-cheeked face, dimples, and soft, wood-brown eyes with golden glints. She has thick, wavy, snow-white hair arranged in becoming puffs and coils. Her voice is described as sounding like white satin, tinkling water, and fairy bells, and she delights in wearing dainty, frilly gowns of cream or forget-me-not organdy.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017)_

## Personality

Miss Lavendar possesses an imaginative, sweet, and romantic disposition, often retreating into a world of dreams and make-believe to ease her loneliness. She is cheerful, warm-hearted, and loves young people, though she admits to a streak of sulkiness when her pride is wounded. Despite her secluded life, she maintains an undying freshness of spirit, humor, and a playful nature.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c23 P12](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0012), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Traits

- Imaginative and romantic  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>
- Proud and sulky when provoked  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Hates growing old  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- Hates visiting relatives out of family duty  <sub>[v2 c21 P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048)</sub>

## Abilities

- Imaginative world-building and pretending  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>
- Skillful flower gardening  <sub>[v2 c21 P51](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0051)</sub>
- Hospitable baking and entertaining  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To preserve her youth and imaginative joy despite her advancing years  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- To reunite in love with Stephen Irving  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c28 P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis lived a quiet, secluded life at Echo Lodge in Grafton. In her youth she was engaged to Stephen Irving, but a foolish misunderstanding and her own proud refusal to forgive him caused their estrangement, after which Stephen left the Island. Over twenty years later, Anne Shirley and Diana Barry stumbled upon her home while lost and were invited to a pretend tea party she had prepared for imagined guests. Anne and Miss Lavendar instantly recognized each other as kindred spirits. Later, Anne introduced Stephen Irving's son, Paul, to Miss Lavendar. The meeting rekindled old memories, leading Anne to inform Stephen Irving that Miss Lavendar was still unmarried. Stephen visited Echo Lodge, where he and Miss Lavendar reconciled after twenty-five years apart. They were married in the garden at Echo Lodge late the following August and departed for a honeymoon trip to the Pacific coast, planning to reside in Boston while keeping Echo Lodge for summer visits.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060), [v2 c28 P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 c30 P10](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0010), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Her father named her Lavendar because he loved the scent of the flower after staying in a lavender-scented bed the night he fell in love with her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Was engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years prior, but parted after a foolish quarrel caused by her coquettishness and sulkiness  <sub>[v2 c23 P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Remained unmarried in the secluded stone house, Echo Lodge, after the deaths of her parents  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P51](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0051), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Employed a succession of young girls all named or renamed 'Charlotta' to keep her company  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> I know you'll think me dreadfully foolish. I am foolish . . . and I'm ashamed of it when I'm found out, but never unless I am found out. I'm not expecting anybody . . . I was just pretending I was.  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>

> A person must have some compensations. I don't believe I could live at times if I didn't pretend things.  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>

> Some are born old maids, some achieve old maidenhood, and some have old maidenhood thrust upon them.  <sub>[v2 c23 P13](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0013)</sub>

> I knew I would rather be an old maid for a thousand years than marry anybody who wasn't Stephen Irving.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

> A broken heart in real life isn't half as dreadful as it is in books. It's a good deal like a bad tooth . . . It takes spells of aching and gives you a sleepless night now and then, but between times it lets you enjoy life and dreams and echoes and peanut candy as if there were nothing the matter with it.  <sub>[v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>


## Relationships

### Stephen Irving

### Anne Shirley

- Friend of — A close friend and kindred spirit who helped bring about her reconciliation with Stephen Irving.  <sub>[v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c28 P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 c28 P44](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0044)</sub>

### Paul Irving

- Parent of — Becomes her stepson upon her marriage to Stephen Irving.  <sub>[v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>

### Charlotta the Fourth (Leonora Bowman)

- Commands — Her devoted little handmaiden at Echo Lodge.  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
